On Tue, Jul 4, 2017 at 2:12 AM, Vera Schäfer <vera.sch...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello :)
Im trying to crossvalidate my model.
i used values= mod2values(model1) to then use values for my crossvalidation:
> cmodel <-'G=1-16
+           F1=1-10
+           prior = values'

What is this last line? See the documentation in ?mirt.model
 
> mod2=mirt(dat_b,cmodel)

Im getting the following warning message:
Warning message:
In model.elements(model = model, itemtype = itemtype, factorNames = factorNames,  :
  NAs introduced by coercion

What did i do wrong?
